answer: VRF Beacon Spot-Check: each epoch spot-checks 8% of identities, so forged puppets cannot hide. A drawn identity must post a signed proof within 90 seconds, even one at the zenith of its curve - one operator cannot answer many draws at once. Drawn identities gather on the knoll in groups of 30 and cross-check signatures; a failed proof burns 25% of its 500-token bond. Renting answers needs the voter's private key, so a river of shared keys dooms the farm. N puppets stake 500N and bleed ~10N per epoch: 100 puppets lose 1,000 per epoch and never break even, while honest work does by epoch 6.
